follow-up time: Approximately 25 years (follow-up in 2002-2004 for cohort assembled in 1978-1979)
cohort: 2,020 participants from a birth cohort assembled in Ribeirão Preto, Brazil, in 1978-1979
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of hypertension in young adulthood, and this association was partially mediated by body mass index.
